scheme.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
scheme.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
scheme.summary: PM-KISAN is a Central Sector scheme with 100% funding from Government of India providing income support of Rs 6,000 per year in three equal installments to all landholding farmers' families.
benefits: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per annum paid in three four-monthly installments of ₹2,000 directly into Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts.
Ensures supplementary financial assistance for procuring agricultural inputs and domestic obligations during crop sowing cycles.
documents_required: Land ownership title / Record of Rights (RoR / Khatauni)
Bank Account details linked with Aadhaar NPCI mapper
State Citizen ID / e-KYC authentication acknowledgment
application_steps: Visit the official PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in) or your local Common Service Centre (CSC).
Click on 'Farmers Corner' and select 'New Farmer Registration'.
Submit Aadhaar number, mobile number, and select state and district.
Enter landholding details including Khata number, Khasra number, and land area in hectares.
Complete mandatory Aadhaar OTP-based or biometric e-KYC to initiate automated DBT validation.

overview.text: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi is a central sector initiative providing direct cash transfers to landholder farmer households across India.
The entire financial outlay is borne directly by the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare with no state matching funds required.

relevance.text: Your profile indicates an active smallholder farmer cultivating 2.5 acres in rural Sehore district.
The direct income assistance helps cover input costs for fertilizers and seeds prior to peak cropping seasons.

eligibility.text: All landholding farmer families having cultivable land in their names are covered under the scheme guidelines.
Institutional landholders, retired pensioners receiving monthly pension over ₹10,000, and income tax payers in the last assessment year remain excluded.

benefits.text: The scheme provides ₹6,000 per financial year released directly into authenticated bank accounts in three equal ₹2,000 transfers.
Payments are scheduled every four months during April-July, August-November, and December-March periods.

documents.text: Applicants must furnish Aadhaar identification, updated revenue land records (Khatauni), and an active Aadhaar-seeded bank account.
Completion of Aadhaar OTP or facial biometric e-KYC verification on the official portal is mandatory to unlock installment disbursal.

application.text: Farmers can self-register online on the PM-KISAN web portal or through authorized Village Level Entrepreneurs at Common Service Centres.
State nodal officers verify land titles with land revenue records before approving direct benefit transfer dispatch.

evidence.text: The Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) scheme provides an income support of Rs. 6000/- per year to all farmer families across the country in three equal four-monthly installments of Rs. 2000/- each.
PM-KISAN is a Central Sector Scheme with 100% funding from Government of India. The funds are transferred directly to the bank accounts of the beneficiaries.
Under the revised guidelines, all landholding farmer families having cultivable land in their names are eligible to receive benefits, subject to existing exclusion criteria.
The financial benefit of Rs. 6,000/- per year shall be disbursed in three four-monthly intervals: April to July, August to November, and December to March.
The scheme aims to supplement the financial needs of farmers in procuring inputs to ensure proper crop health and appropriate yields at each cycle.
Institutional land holders are excluded. Former and present holders of constitutional posts, ministers, MPs, MLAs, and Mayors are strictly ineligible.
All persons who paid income tax in last assessment year and professionals like Doctors, Engineers, Lawyers, Chartered Accountants are not eligible.
For the purpose of registration, the landholder farmer must submit Aadhaar card, proof of cultivable land records, and IFSC-enabled bank account number.
e-KYC is mandatory for PM-KISAN registered farmers. OTP based e-KYC is available on PMKISAN Portal or biometric authentication can be done at CSC centres.
Farmers can self-register at pmkisan.gov.in or through Common Service Centers (CSCs) on payment of prescribed service fees.
State/UT Governments will verify the eligibility of beneficiaries and upload the approved list to the portal before fund transfer.
